title: Xianghui Scholarship

text: I was admitted to the [Department of Macromolecular Science, Fudan University](https://polymer.fudan.edu.cn/).
title: A New Chapter at Fudan

text: I successfully graduated from the New Energy Materials and Devices (Elite Class) of Guohao College of Tongji University and was awarded a bachelor's degree in engineering.
title: Graduation from Tongji

text: Our work on '[Aqueously dispersed homopolypeptide nanotoroids with tunable circularly polarized luminescence](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1001841725010228)' has been published in [Chinese Chemical Letters](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/chinese-chemical-letters "Go to Chinese Chemical Letters on ScienceDirect").
I was awarded the title of 'Outstanding Graduate Student of Shanghai' by Tongji University and Guohao College.
I was awarded the title of 'Academic Star Pacemaker' by Tongji University (The Highest Honor in the Field of Undergraduate Academic Achievements).
I was recommended by Guohao College for direct admission to graduate school, and I also received an admission offer from the Department of Polymer Science at Fudan University.
I received the Alishan Scholarship (First Prize of the Outstanding Student Scholarship, Only Two Undergraduate Students were Awarded at Tongji University).

Our work on '[Engineering circularly polarized luminescence through symmetry manipulation in achiral tetraphenylpyrazine structures](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0254586124003428)' has been published in [Chinese Journal of Structural Chemistry](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/chinese-journal-of-structural-chemistry "Go to Chinese Journal of Structural Chemistry on ScienceDirect").
I received the CRRC Zhuzhou Locomotive Scholarship at Tongji University (First Prize of the Outstanding Student Scholarship).
I was admitted to the [Engineering Experimental Class (Guohao Elite Class) of Tongji University](https://ghc.tongji.edu.cn/info/1051/2201.htm) through an interview.
